choices.question: In Switzerland in 2020, were more hours worked paid or unpaid?
Estimated value of all unpaid work in 2020?
Share of household production in the extended total economy?

overallFeedback.feedback: In Switzerland in 2020, 9.8 billion hours were worked unpaid, more than the 7.6 billion hours of paid work. Unpaid work was valued at CHF 434 billion, and household production made up 41.4% of the value added of the extended total economy. Most of this work is done by women, and none of it appears in GDP.
